decision: A feature chain, as KerML 8.2.5.8.2 states it.
notes:
THIS IS THE KERML VARIANT (ADR-0014). The other language states this production differently and is a separate unit, derived from its own clause and not consulted here. No Xtext rule of this name exists; the pilot inlines it into FeatureChainMember.

The two languages' bodies differ in factoring and, as far as their expansions go, accept the same text. That is recorded, not relied on: equivalence across languages is not something this unit asserts, which is why the production was split at all.
